A comb, razor and trimmer rest in the work area. The barber confirms the desired length before starting. reading.title: Choosing a service
reading.text: The barber shows a shaving brush, spray bottle and cape. At the mirror, Omar describes his haircut. A strop belongs to professional razor maintenance, not the style itself. The menu separates a shave, beard trim and line up. Omar chooses a beard trim. He asks about a hot towel, shampoo and conditioning. He also learns the difference between styling, coloring and highlights, but chooses styling today. The barber does not assume permission for another service. This vocabulary account explains names and purposes without giving blade-use, heat or chemical instructions.
